text: Share (0–1) of other users' comments that contain at least one explicit agreement marker, i.e. words expressly stating agreement with a point by the OP or another party (e.g. "I agree", "you're right", "fair point", "exactly"). Source: OC_comments (JSON list of other-user comments, parsed); output is marked comments divided by total comments, order ignored. Implicit agreement and mere politeness don't count; markers inside quoted text from someone else being rebutted don't count; moderator/bot notices are excluded. OP view-change or delta-award announcements, post-outcome thank-you/resolution updates, and text reporting whether the outcome occurred are not evidence (generic delta/platform-rule discussion is allowed). Empty valid list or missing/malformed input gives null; 0 means no comment has a marker.
